note: Reference/edit conditioning: LoadImage(10) is reference image 0, ReferenceMultiLatent(12) holds the reference budget. Bounding boxes belong in the prompt (model card). 'files' declares the uploaded parameters: image and reference are two names for the same ability (a package sets whichever word its asset used) and both land on node 10, so a package that sets both to different files would have one silently win - the planner reads gen.inputs and a well-formed asset sets one of them.
